verses.ar: وَسَكَنَ رُؤَسَاءُ ٱلشَّعْبِ فِي أُورُشَلِيمَ، وَأَلْقَى سَائِرُ ٱلشَّعْبِ قُرَعًا لِيَأْتُوا بِوَاحِدٍ مِنْ عَشَرَةٍ لِلسُّكْنَى فِي أُورُشَلِيمَ، مَدِينَةِ ٱلْقُدْسِ، وَٱلتِّسْعَةِ ٱلْأَقْسَامِ فِي ٱلْمُدُنِ.
verses.kjv: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts [to dwell] in [other] cities.
verses.web: The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem. The rest of the people also cast lots to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.

verses.ar: وَبَارَكَ ٱلشَّعْبُ جَمِيعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱنْتَدَبُوا لِلسَّكْنَى فِي أُورُشَلِيمَ.
verses.kjv: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.
verses.web: The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.

verses.ar: وَهَؤُلَاءِ هُمْ رُؤُوسُ ٱلْبِلَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ سَكَنُوا فِي أُورُشَلِيمَ وَفِي مُدُنِ يَهُوذَا. سَكَنَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ فِي مُلْكِهِ، فِي مُدُنِهِمْ مِنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، ٱلْكَهَنَةُ وَٱللَّاَوِيُّونَ وَٱلنَّثِينِيمُ وَبَنُو عَبِيدِ سُلَيْمَانَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Now these [are] the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, [to wit], Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon’s servants.
verses.web: Now these are the chiefs of the province who lived in Jerusalem; but in the cities of Judah, everyone lived in his possession in their cities—Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants.

verses.ar: وَسَكَنَ فِي أُورُشَلِيمَ مِنْ بَنِي يَهُوذَا وَمِنْ بَنِي بَنْيَامِينَ. فَمِنْ بَنِي يَهُوذَا: عَثَايَا بْنُ عُزِّيَّا بْنِ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ أَمَرْيَا بْنِ شَفَطْيَا بْنِ مَهْلَلْئِيلَ مِنْ بَنِي فَارَصَ.
verses.kjv: And at Jerusalem dwelt [certain] of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;
verses.web: Some of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin lived in Jerusalem. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;

verses.ar: وَمَعْسِيَّا بْنُ بَارُوخَ بْنِ كَلْحُوزَةَ بْنِ حَزَايَا بْنِ عَدَايَا بْنِ يُويَارِيبَ بْنِ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ ٱلشِّيلُونِيِّ.
verses.kjv: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.
verses.web: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.

verses.ar: جَمِيعُ بَنِي فَارَصَ ٱلسَّاكِنِينَ فِي أُورُشَلِيمَ أَرْبَعُ مِئَةٍ وَثَمَانِيَةٌ وَسِتُّونَ مِنْ رِجَالِ ٱلْبَأْسِ.
verses.kjv: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem [were] four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.
verses.web: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men.

verses.ar: وَهَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو بِنْيَامِينَ: سَلُّو بْنُ مَشُلَّامَ بْنِ يُوعِيدَ بْنِ فَدَايَا بْنِ قُولَايَا بْنِ مَعْسِيَّا بْنِ إِيثِيئِيلَ بْنِ يَشَعْيَا.
verses.kjv: And these [are] the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.
verses.web: These are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.

verses.ar: وَبَعْدَهُ جَبَّايُ سَلَّايُ. تِسْعُ مِئَةٍ وَثَمَانِيَةٌ وَعِشْرُونَ.
verses.kjv: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.
verses.web: After him Gabbai and Sallai, nine hundred twenty-eight.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ يُوئِيلُ بْنُ زِكْرِي وَكِيلًا عَلَيْهِمْ، وَيَهُوذَا بْنُ هَسْنُوآةَ ثَانِيًا عَلَى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ.
verses.kjv: And Joel the son of Zichri [was] their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah [was] second over the city.
verses.web: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.

verses.ar: مِنَ ٱلْكَهَنَةِ: يَدَعْيَا بْنُ يُويَارِيبَ وَيَاكِينُ،
verses.kjv: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.
verses.web: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,

verses.ar: وَسَرَايَا بْنُ حِلْقِيَّا بْنِ مَشُلَّامَ بْنِ صَادُوقَ بْنِ مَرَايُوثَ بْنِ أَخِيطُوبَ رَئِيسُ بَيْتِ ٱللهِ.
verses.kjv: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, [was] the ruler of the house of God.
verses.web: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house,

verses.ar: وَإِخْوَتُهُمْ عَامِلُو ٱلْعَمَلِ لِلْبَيْتِ ثَمَانُ مِئَةٍ وَٱثْنَانِ وَعِشْرُونَ. وَعَدَايَا بْنُ يَرُوحَامَ بْنِ فَلَلْيَا بْنِ أَمْصِي بْنِ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ فَشْحُورَ بْنِ مَلْكِيَّا،
verses.kjv: And their brethren that did the work of the house [were] eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah,
verses.web: and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,

verses.ar: وَإِخْوَتُهُ رُؤُوسُ ٱلْآبَاءِ مِئَتَانِ وَٱثْنَانِ وَأَرْبَعُونَ. وَعَمْشِسَايُ بْنُ عَزَرْئِيلَ بْنِ أَخْزَايَ بْنِ مَشْلِيمُوثَ بْنِ إِمِّيرَ،
verses.kjv: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
verses.web: and his brothers, chiefs of fathers’ households, two hundred forty-two; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

verses.ar: وَإِخْوَتُهُمْ جَبَابِرَةُ بَأْسٍ مِئَةٌ وَثَمَانِيَةٌ وَعِشْرُونَ. وَٱلْوَكِيلُ عَلَيْهِمْ زَبْدِيئِيلُ بْنُ هَجْدُولِيمَ.
verses.kjv: And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer [was] Zabdiel, the son of [one of] the great men.
verses.web: and their brothers, mighty men of valor, one hundred twenty-eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱللَّاوِيِّينَ: شَمَعْيَا بْنُ حَشُّوبَ بْنِ عَزْرِيقَامَ بْنِ حَشَبْيَا بْنِ بُونِّي،
verses.kjv: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
verses.web: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

verses.ar: وَشَبْتَايُ وَيُوزَابَادُ عَلَى ٱلْعَمَلِ ٱلْخَارِجِيِّ لِبَيْتِ ٱللهِ مِنْ رُؤُوسِ ٱللَّاوِيِّينَ.
verses.kjv: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, [had] the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.
verses.web: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of God’s house;

verses.ar: وَمَتَّنْيَا بْنُ مِيخَا بْنِ زَبْدِي بْنِ آسَافَ، رَئِيسُ ٱلتَّسْبِيحِ يُحَمِّدُ فِي ٱلصَّلَاةِ وَبَقْبُقْيَا ٱلثَّانِي بَيْنَ إِخْوَتِهِ، وَعَبْدَا بْنُ شَمُّوعَ بْنِ جَلَالَ بْنِ يَدُوثُونَ.
verses.kjv: And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, [was] the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
verses.web: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

verses.ar: جَمِيعُ ٱللَّاَوِيِّينَ فِي ٱلْمَدِينَةِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةِ مِئَتَانِ وَثَمَانِيَةٌ وَأَرْبَعُونَ.
verses.kjv: All the Levites in the holy city [were] two hundred fourscore and four.
verses.web: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.

verses.ar: وَٱلْبَوَّابُونَ: عَقُّوبُ وَطَلْمُونُ وَإِخْوَتُهُمَا حَارِسُو ٱلْأَبْوَابِ مِئَةٌ وَٱثْنَانِ وَسَبْعُونَ.
verses.kjv: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates, [were] an hundred seventy and two.
verses.web: Moreover the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates, were one hundred seventy-two.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ سَائِرُ إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْكَهَنَةِ وَٱللَّاَوِيِّينَ فِي جَمِيعِ مُدُنِ يَهُوذَا، كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ فِي مِيرَاثِهِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the residue of Israel, of the priests, [and] the Levites, [were] in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.
verses.web: The residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلنَّثِينِيمُ فَسَكَنُوا فِي ٱلْأَكَمَةِ. وَكَانَ صِيحَا وَجِشْفَا عَلَى ٱلنَّثِينِيمِ.
verses.kjv: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa [were] over the Nethinims.
verses.web: But the temple servants lived in Ophel; and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ وَكِيلَ ٱللَّاَوِيِّينَ فِي أُورُشَلِيمَ عَلَى عَمَلِ بَيْتِ ٱللهِ عُزِّي بْنُ بَانِيَ بْنِ حَشَبْيَا بْنِ مَتَّنْيَا بْنِ مِيخَا مِنْ بَنِي آسَافَ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ.
verses.kjv: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem [was] Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers [were] over the business of the house of God.
verses.web: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers responsible for the service of God’s house.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ وَصِيَّةَ ٱلْمَلِكِ مِنْ جِهَتِهِمْ كَانَتْ أَنَّ لِلْمُرَنِّمِينَ فَرِيضَةً أَمْرَ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ فَيَوْمٍ.
verses.kjv: For [it was] the king’s commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.
verses.web: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.

verses.ar: وَفَتَحْيَا بْنُ مَشِيزَبْئِيلَ مِنْ بَنِي زَارَحَ بْنِ يَهُوذَا، كَانَ تَحْتَ يَدِ ٱلْمَلِكِ فِي كُلِّ أُمُورِ ٱلشَّعْبِ.
verses.kjv: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, [was] at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.
verses.web: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.

verses.ar: وَفِي ٱلضِّيَاعِ مَعَ حُقُولِهَا سَكَنَ مِنْ بَنِي يَهُوذَا فِي قَرْيَةِ أَرْبَعَ وَقُرَاهَا، وَدِيبُونَ وَقُرَاهَا، وَفِي يَقَبْصِئِيلَ وَضِيَاعِهَا،
verses.kjv: And for the villages, with their fields, [some] of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjath-arba, and [in] the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and [in] the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and [in] the villages thereof,
verses.web: As for the villages with their fields, some of the children of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its towns, in Dibon and its towns, in Jekabzeel and its villages,

verses.ar: وَفِي يَشُوعَ وَمُولَادَةَ وَبَيْتِ فَالِطَ،
verses.kjv: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Beth-phelet,
verses.web: in Jeshua, in Moladah, Beth Pelet,

verses.ar: وَفِي حَصَرَ شُوعَالَ وَبِئْرِ سَبْعٍ وَقُرَاهَا،
verses.kjv: And at Hazar-shual, and at Beer-sheba, and [in] the villages thereof,
verses.web: in Hazar Shual, in Beersheba and its towns,

verses.ar: وَفِي صِقْلَغَ وَمَكُونَةَ وَقُرَاهَا،
verses.kjv: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,
verses.web: in Ziklag, in Meconah and in its towns,

verses.ar: وَفِي عَيْنِ رِمُّونَ وَصَرْعَةَ وَيِرْمُوثَ،
verses.kjv: And at En-rimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,
verses.web: in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,

verses.ar: وَزَانُوحَ وَعَدُلَّامَ وَضِيَاعِهِمَا، وَلَخِيشَ وَحُقُولِهَا، وَعَزِيقَةَ وَقُرَاهَا، وَحَلُّوا مِنْ بِئْرِ سَبْعٍ إِلَى وَادِي هِنُّومَ.
verses.kjv: Zanoah, Adullam, and [in] their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and [in] the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beer-sheba unto the valley of Hinnom.
verses.web: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and its fields, and Azekah and its towns. So they encamped from Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom.

verses.ar: وَبَنُو بَنْيَامِينَ سَكَنُوا مِنْ جَبَعَ إِلَى مِخْمَاسَ وَعَيَّا وَبَيْتِ إِيلٍ وَقُرَاهَا،
verses.kjv: The children also of Benjamin from Geba [dwelt] at Michmash, and Aija, and Beth-el, and [in] their villages,
verses.web: The children of Benjamin also lived from Geba onward, at Michmash and Aija, and at Bethel and its towns,

verses.ar: وَعَنَاثُوثَ وَنُوبٍ وَعَنَنْيَةَ،
verses.kjv: [And] at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
verses.web: at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

verses.ar: وَحَاصُورَ وَرَامَةَ وَجِتَّايِمَ،
verses.kjv: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
verses.web: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

verses.ar: وَحَادِيدَ وَصَبُوعِيمَ وَنَبَلَّاَطَ،
verses.kjv: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
verses.web: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

verses.ar: وَلُودٍ وَأُونُوَ وَادِي ٱلصُّنَّاعِ.
verses.kjv: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.
verses.web: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱللَّاَوِيِّينَ فِرَقٌ فِي يَهُوذَا وَفِي بِنْيَامِينَ.
verses.kjv: And of the Levites [were] divisions [in] Judah, [and] in Benjamin.
verses.web: Of the Levites, certain divisions in Judah settled in Benjamin’s territory.
